selection_policy: Primary physical targets are selected through source-target-charter and a reviewed target-scope record. Structural prerequisites and mathematical examples have distinct classes. Selection adds the target's required bindings to sector realization; unrelated targets impose no prerequisites.

targets.regime: Native Bool spectral complex interpretation and retained return
targets.recovery_law: Source operations, retained schedules and complex/real action/readout maps commute at the accepted verification level.

targets.regime: Same Bool source, C4 to R8, theta=pi*t and z*Hz=2E_H
targets.existing_result: Accepted finite source overlap; programme binding remains a named task
targets.recovery_law: Same-source action, return and quadratic readout transport with explicit parameter/orientation conventions.

targets.regime: 137 coefficient slots, declared interface-preserving generator and full retained T9
targets.existing_result: Hamiltonian transport, active observer and energy-task control
targets.recovery_law: Energy/dynamics and complete source reconstruction agree under the retained chart.

targets.regime: To be frozen: physical realization of the declared retained coefficient model
targets.recovery_law: Source-selected preparations and controls reproduce the model dynamics and calibrated energy records in a declared regime.
targets.independent_test: Freeze a gain/energy prediction with independently calibrated intervention and complete resource/record policy.
targets.failure_test: Calibrated response excludes the source-derived prediction or a required operation cannot be realized.

targets.regime: Declared reciprocal lossy cavity and/or finite-memory photodetection instrument; choose exact instance during review
targets.recovery_law: The common-source map preserves ordered port composition, memory/loss, preparation and complete record probabilities or calibrated amplitudes for the chosen model.
allowed_inputs: source-authorized preparation and detector record policy
missing: frozen chosen instance and law-derivation claim
targets.independent_test: Compare predeclared multi-step records or port responses, including dark-output/stored-state or detector-memory discriminators.
targets.failure_test: The common-source prediction fails a complete-record test or erases state needed by the next source operation.

targets.regime: Free unpolarized electron target, specified incident energy and setting-independent polar support; retain rejection/no-click records
targets.recovery_law: Complete effects normalize; for the specified prepared eigenstate p_plus=1/2+mu/pi under the imported Born/Klein-Nishina model.
allowed_inputs: imported Born pairing and Klein-Nishina law
targets.independent_test: Predeclare sample/stopping rule and nuisance policy, then compare held-out complete records.
targets.failure_test: Held-out records exclude the specified interface under its frozen assumptions.

targets.regime: Conditional native endpoint/contact model with 2+8 product-record leads; precise energy and cutoff regime selected during review
targets.recovery_law: Source-derived contacts/switching, completed model predictions and identified preparation/species/detector maps reproduce the specified scattering records.
targets.independent_test: Freeze a source-sensitive discriminator that survives the relative-scale alias and numerical uncertainty.
targets.failure_test: Residuals exceed the declared error budget or candidate source/species remain indistinguishable under the proposed record protocol.

targets.regime: Phase-locked one-mode discrete round-trip cavity; complete four-port dilation; finite sequences of at most three round trips
targets.recovery_law: Preserve ordered amplitude maps, returning state, energy metric, environment and delayed composition under the declared mirror/loss law.
allowed_inputs: independently frozen mirror/loss/phase/delay and amplitude-readout calibration
targets.independent_test: Dark-reflection preparation followed by zero drive reveals retained field; compare complete ordered responses and resource accounts.
targets.failure_test: A required square fails or calibrated complete records exclude the frozen prediction tube at the charter tolerance.

targets.regime: At most one prepared photon per bin, ready/dead memory, no-click retained, one-step recovery; sequences of at most three bins
targets.recovery_law: Preserve sequential click/no-click probabilities, preparation order, memory update and complete-record normalization under the declared instrument.
targets.independent_test: Compare full records for photon-photon and photon-vacuum-photon sequences against immediate-reset and retained-memory predictions.
targets.failure_test: A memory/record square fails or calibrated complete records exclude the frozen prediction set at the charter tolerance.

deferred_expansions.missing: Source-derived field phase space, Lorentzian geometry, constraint/smearing laws and physical map
deferred_expansions.reopening: A versioned field target with explicit source construction and recovery test

deferred_expansions.missing: Common physical substrate, preparation/ports, clock and independent gain/calibration binding
deferred_expansions.reopening: A bounded flavor target with separately sourced input laws and independent discriminator

deferred_expansions.missing: Physical action, state/preparation, units and readout map for a selected prediction
deferred_expansions.reopening: A source-derived prediction and frozen physical test interface
